schema.name: _audit_log_
schema.description: Audit trail of security-relevant actions: who did what, to what, when, from where, and with what outcome.

019fdc60-69cd-701b-9fcb-c60a227a5a22.name: recorded_at
019fdc60-69cd-701b-9fcb-c60a227a5a22.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this record was written. Compare with occurred_at to detect ingestion lag or clock skew.

019fdc60-69cd-7025-bac1-e03ab63af3cd.name: request_id
019fdc60-69cd-7025-bac1-e03ab63af3cd.description: Identifier of the originating request, if applicable.

019fdc60-69cd-7023-ae15-b565086044a3.name: latency_ms
019fdc60-69cd-7023-ae15-b565086044a3.description: Duration of the underlying operation, in milliseconds.

019fdc60-69cd-7028-993b-c309eed292b5.name: error_code
019fdc60-69cd-7028-993b-c309eed292b5.description: Machine-readable error/denial code, present when status is failure, denied, or error.

019fdc60-69cd-7027-b867-7ef2862423b4.name: operation
019fdc60-69cd-7027-b867-7ef2862423b4.description: Coarse-grained action category, for consistent filtering across all producers.

019fdc60-69cd-7016-8969-e934b8ae87fd.name: region
019fdc60-69cd-7016-8969-e934b8ae87fd.description: Deployment region or data center of the emitting service.

019fdc60-69cd-7015-8e28-7c852d323fc7.name: session_id
019fdc60-69cd-7015-8e28-7c852d323fc7.description: Non-secret session/token identifier. Never store raw credentials, tokens, or secrets here.

019fdc60-69cd-7024-8716-c48cd2883a60.name: event_name
019fdc60-69cd-7024-8716-c48cd2883a60.description: Fine-grained, human-readable event taxonomy, e.g. "user.login.failed" or "invoice.updated". Complements operation/resource_type with producer-specific detail.

019fdc60-69cd-702b-ad82-677a7671314a.name: service_name
019fdc60-69cd-702b-ad82-677a7671314a.description: The service/component that emitted this audit record.

019fdc60-69cd-7019-8f6b-9e9df3fbd2b4.name: event_id
019fdc60-69cd-7019-8f6b-9e9df3fbd2b4.description: Unique identifier for this audit record itself (UUIDv7).

019fdc60-69cd-7020-925c-b30e646b2ebf.name: error_message
019fdc60-69cd-7020-925c-b30e646b2ebf.description: Human-readable error detail. Avoid embedding secrets or PII beyond what's already logged elsewhere.

019fdc60-69cd-7022-bff0-58fd34b1af45.name: resource_type
019fdc60-69cd-7022-bff0-58fd34b1af45.description: The kind of resource acted upon, e.g. "invoice", "user_account", "api_key".

019fdc60-69cd-7017-a753-51fbbcd816d7.name: metadata
019fdc60-69cd-7017-a753-51fbbcd816d7.description: Additional producer-specific context that doesn't warrant a first-class field.

019fdc60-69cd-7018-9ed4-55b863a12509.name: integrity_hash
019fdc60-69cd-7018-9ed4-55b863a12509.description: Hash of this record chained with the previous record's hash, for tamper-evidence. Populated by the log writer, never by the emitting service.

019fdc60-69cd-701c-9625-714db6ad22aa.name: actor_id
019fdc60-69cd-701c-9625-714db6ad22aa.description: Identifier of who or what performed the action. Use "system" for automated/internal actors.

019fdc60-69cd-701d-ada2-5b3846cc57f6.name: resource_id
019fdc60-69cd-701d-ada2-5b3846cc57f6.description: Identifier of the specific resource instance acted upon.

019fdc60-69cd-701a-994a-1c1ae18f8aa0.name: occurred_at
019fdc60-69cd-701a-994a-1c1ae18f8aa0.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the audited action actually took place.

019fdc60-69cd-7029-98d6-e7e81d36c913.name: source_ip
019fdc60-69cd-7029-98d6-e7e81d36c913.description: Originating IP address of the actor.

019fdc60-69cc-7014-befa-b56800e9839b.name: trace_id
019fdc60-69cc-7014-befa-b56800e9839b.description: Distributed trace/correlation ID linking this event to related events across services.

019fdc60-69cd-7014-895e-bc5dbf1b49b3.name: on_behalf_of_id
019fdc60-69cd-7014-895e-bc5dbf1b49b3.description: Set when actor_id is acting on behalf of another identity (delegation/impersonation), e.g. an admin or service acting for a user.

schema.name: _workflow_definition_
schema.description: Workflow definition storage for the hermes workflow engine
